decision_question: Does the prospective program enforce a finite three-round architecture comparison, one-time sealed confirmation, non-human claim boundaries, and immutable evidence for every run outcome?

hard_gates.name: historical-baseline-immutable
hard_gates.evidence: Program 011, V2.1, the actual-product autonomy harness, and the finite-loop policy are hash-bound baseline artifacts.

hard_gates.name: fresh-confirmation-isolated
hard_gates.evidence: The one fresh confirmation tranche is absent from all three architecture development rounds and permits one execution.

hard_gates.name: every-run-recorded
hard_gates.evidence: The manifest requires a run ID, manifest, record, summary, registry row, hashes, accounting, limitations, and GitHub checkpoint for every outcome.

hard_gates.name: nonhuman-claim-boundary
hard_gates.evidence: The program prohibits real-professor fidelity and real-student learning claims from LLM and simulator evidence.

hard_gates.name: provider-authority-closed
hard_gates.evidence: Provider and paid execution remain unauthorized; this build made zero calls and opened no hidden gold.

decision.rationale: Keep the finite recording and selection infrastructure, then complete the causal audit and freeze independent development tranches before implementing Round 1 candidates.

limitations: No product or provider quality was evaluated.
The three development folds and final proxy datasets remain planned rather than frozen.
The program cannot establish real-professor fidelity, real-student usability, or real-student learning improvement.
